title: Paper Claim Unit Standard: Filing and Decision Rules (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**Standard.** A paper claim under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit reimburses a member who paid out of pocket for a covered prescription. It is filed with the itemized receipt the network requires, and a submission without one is denied for a missing receipt.

## Clauses in force

1. **Filing limit.** A paper claim is payable only when it is received no later than the network's filing limit in calendar days after the date of service, the date of service being day zero; one received later is denied as filed late.
2. **Ended coverage.** For a member whose coverage has ended, a paper claim for a date of service while covered must also arrive within the Pharmacy Benefit Plan's claims run-out period, and the earlier of the two deadlines governs.
3. **Denial reasons.** A paper claim is denied:
   - as not eligible on the date of service, when the member had no active plan coverage on the date of service;
   - as a duplicate of a paid claim, when a paid, unreversed retail claim exists for the same drug, date of service and pharmacy;
   - as not covered, when the drug is not covered on the member's formulary on that date;
   - as coverage review required, when the drug needs a coverage review that has no approval in force on the date of service.
4. **Receipt date.** The receipt date is the received date on the submission, whenever the decision is made.
5. **Decision.** Each paper claim is decided within the network's processing days of receipt, and a submission takes exactly one decision. A submission may be decided only when it has no approval or denial yet, as the paper-claim records show.

## The filing limit on the calendar (hypothetical)

Take a network whose filing limit is 90 days and a receipt whose date of service is day 0. The received date on the submission decides the outcome:

| Received on | Outcome under clause 1 |
|---|---|
| Day 90 | Within the limit — the last day it may be received |
| Day 91 | Denied as filed late |

For a member whose coverage ended and whose plan's run-out period would close on day 60, the earlier deadline, day 60, governs instead of day 90.

## Basis of each check

| Check | Rests on |
|---|---|
| Filing limit | The date of service and the received date on the submission |
| One decision only | The approvals and denials already recorded against that submission |
| Duplicate of a paid claim | Paid, unreversed retail claims for the same drug, date of service and pharmacy |

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

The following clauses are no longer in force; they have been superseded by the current basis and are kept only as retired text:

- "Out-of-network fills are reimbursed only as the network's out-of-network coverage allows: under emergency-only coverage only for an urgent fill of at most the network's emergency out-of-network days supply made while no network pharmacy was reasonably available; foreign purchases only where the network covers foreign claims."
- "Paper claims are priced per the network's pricing basis: the reimbursement is the allowed amount (the network rate, multiplied by the network's out-of-network rate for an out-of-network fill) capped at the amount the member paid, less the member cost share the plan would have charged on that date, never below zero; an approved amount below the minimum payment is approved without payment."

superseded_clauses: Out-of-network fills are reimbursed only as oon_coverage allows: under emergency_only only for an urgent fill of at most oon_emergency_days_supply_max days made while no network pharmacy was reasonably available; foreign purchases only when dmr_foreign_claims_covered is true.

Paper claims are priced per dmr_reimbursement_basis: the reimbursement is the allowed amount (the network rate, multiplied by oon_reimbursement_rate for an out-of-network fill) capped at the amount the member paid, less the member cost share the plan would have charged on that date, never below zero; an approved amount below dmr_minimum_payment is approved without payment.
